name: Lamont Summer Academy
org: University of Denver, Lamont School of Music
what_you_do: Spend two weeks at the University of Denver music school. Play or sing in lessons, ensembles, and classes. Singers, players, and composers can all join.
who_can_apply: Students ages 13 to 18. You send audition videos. Composers send three original works.
pay_detail: Residential $2,850. Commuter $2,000. Commuter PLUS $2,200. There is also a $75 application fee. Almost 70 percent of students get aid.
deadline_text: The program page lists three dates for the 2027 session: Dec 15 for priority decisions, Feb 15 for scholarship consideration, and Mar 15 for regular applications. The page does not write the year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Upload audition videos and pay the $75 fee. Ask one teacher to email a recommendation. For need-based aid, email a tax form.
notes: This costs money, but scholarships exist. You must meet the Feb 15 date to be considered for them.
